description: Stage 3c gate: the show thread must keep advancing while the editor thread is stalled. Loads the gradient PNG sequence, starts playback, then blocks the editor thread for 500 ms via StallEditor (simulating a Win32 modal loop). The show thread paces itself at 60 Hz via QPC sleep_until, so 500 ms should yield >= 20 show-thread ticks. The assertion fails if the condvar gate (Stage 3b) is accidentally re-introduced or the show thread deadlocks. (Was SleepMs until issue #74 — SleepMs no longer blocks the editor thread, which had quietly weakened this test.)
